subject: Evidence intake: SCIM delta, SAML samples, and admin justification
messages:
From: security@mediwell.com <security@mediwell.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: audit-team@thirdparty-audit.com
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SCIM/SAML & admin evidence for upcoming SIG

Hi Olga,

Hope you're well — MediWell's audit window for SIG/SOC2 is the week of Nov 8. Our external audit team has flagged a few items we need from Redwood to complete the access control section. Can you confirm availability and lead contact? Requested artifacts: 

- SCIM delta export covering last 90 days (example format + delta rows)
- Representative SAML assertion samples for SAML 2.0 logins (redacted)
- Role-to-permission matrix for tenant-scoped and org-scoped roles
- List of active users with admin/privileged roles and justification for each (most recent access review)
- Evidence of least-privilege policy (process doc or policy excerpt)
- Audit log sample showing an admin role change (timestamps + actor)

Due date: Nov 3 COB (so auditors can ingest before their Nov 8 window). If any of the items require formal redaction or additional POA, please flag and provide ETA.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Regards,
Mina Shah
Security Manager, MediWell
security@mediwell.com

Attachments: none
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Mina Shah <security@mediwell.com>
Cc: audit-team@thirdparty-audit.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM/SAML & admin evidence for upcoming SIG

Mina — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Looping in Laura (security lead) and Karthik (infra/SCIM owner) plus Marissa from CS to coordinate timelines.

Quick plan: 
- I'll own the intake, assemble the role matrix and admin list (will provide a justification template).
- Karthik will extract SCIM delta and a sample SAML assertion with redaction notes.
- Laura will validate the audit log slice and least-privilege policy excerpt.
- Marissa will help coordinate delivery and signatures for your auditors.

Question: for the SCIM delta, do you want the raw CSV export or a redacted sample only? We can provide both: a redacted sample now and secure transfer of the full export under an SFTP link if that works.

I'll attach our evidence intake template to capture user-level justification and any required redactions. ETA: preliminary bundle by 2026-10-29 EOD; final proofs by 2026-11-02 if no blockers. Will that meet your internal deadlines?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: evidence_intake_template.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, Mina Shah <security@mediwell.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM/SAML & admin evidence for upcoming SIG

Olga / team — prepping the technical artifacts. Notes below: 

1) SCIM delta: we can produce a CSV with add/update/delete rows for the requested 90-day window. Samples will include attributes: userId, externalId, userName, email, meta.created, meta.lastModified, operations (["create","update","delete"]).
   - Sample (attached): scim_delta_sample.csv (contains synthetic/test rows — PII redacted).
   - Full export can be staged to an SFTP bucket (we'll provide link + temporary credentials). Please confirm if MediWell auditors require encrypted transfer with a specific cipher.

2) SAML assertions: we will provide 3 redacted assertion examples (desktop login, mobile SSO, service-account assertion used for provisioning). Each will be scrubbed of NameID and any direct email addresses. Attached: saml_assertion_sample.xml (redacted).

3) Role matrix: current master lives in internal drive (link below). I can cut a tenant-scoped subset for MediWell and include permission IDs and descriptions. We'll mark any service roles that require bundling exceptions.

4) Admin/user justification: Olga's intake template should capture justification, last access review date, and owner. For users flagged as privileged, we'll include an access log snippet showing last use.

Drive link for artifacts (internal): https://drive.redwood/workspace/attachments/MW-evidence-2026 — will populate folder and post final links.

Redaction plan: full exports will have PII removed or replaced with stable hashes unless you request otherwise. Expect my preliminary artifacts attached.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Infra / Identity, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: scim_delta_sample.csv, saml_assertion_sample.xml
From: Mina Shah <security@mediwell.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: audit-team@thirdparty-audit.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2026 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM/SAML & admin evidence for upcoming SIG

Thanks — that level of detail is perfect. A couple of follow-ups before you stage the full export: 

- For the admin list, can you include a one-line justification for these specific accounts we flagged in our tracker: alice.jenkins, prod-sys-admin, vendor-provisioner? We need to capture owner+business reason.
- For audit/role-change logs, please ensure timestamps are in UTC in the snippets and include the actor email (redacted if external).
- SFTP transfer works; require AES-256 encryption for the file container. We'll provide a short secure upload form if you'd prefer to push directly into our intake portal.

If you can get the preliminary bundle to us by Oct 29 EOD, auditors will be able to prioritize ingestion. Appreciate the quick turnaround — LMK if you want a 20-min sync tomorrow morning.

Best regards,
Mina Shah
Security Manager, MediWell
security@mediwell.com

Attachments: none
